title: autopilot.json of a project
description: The state of the autopilot controller of a project (<runs root>/autopilot.json), replaced atomically after every change while the controller holds <runs root>/autopilot.lock: the plan, the session limits and counters, the deadline, the conductor run it drives now (written as a launch intent before the child is started), the runs that wait for answers, the last runs and blockers, and the stop that ended the session.

plan.description: Collection of the work source the session works through.

start_ticks.description: Start time of the controller process in clock ticks since boot (/proc/<pid>/stat), null when unknown.

boot_id.description: Boot id of the machine the controller runs on, null when unknown.

started_at.description: UTC time the session started; a restart after a crash keeps it.

updated_at.description: UTC time of the last write.

deadline_at.description: UTC time started_at + max_wall_s; written at the first start of the session and never moved by a restart.

mode.description: running, paused (no new work), draining (finish the current run, then stop) or stopped.

recoveries.description: Resumes the controller started per run after a crash, a hang or a one-time failure (max_recoveries per run).

current.description: The conductor run the controller drives now, null when none.

quota_wait.description: A stopped run waiting for the reset of a provider quota, null when none.

run_id.description: The run to resume after the reset.

waiting_runs.description: Runs that ended waiting for answers (exit 4) with a clean tree; continued once their questions are answered.

history.description: The last runs (at most 50), oldest first; one entry per run id.

last_blockers.description: The blockers of the last runs, newest last (the same item and code twice in a row is AUTOPILOT_REPEATED_BLOCKER).

stop.description: Why the session ended, null while it runs.

limits.description: The effective limits of the session (policy merged with the flags of start).

run_tokens_hard_max.description: Run cap handed to each run (0: none).

max_no_progress_runs.description: Runs in a row without a closed piece.

max_auto_decisions.description: Questions answered by the advisor or panel.

no_progress_streak.description: Runs in a row that closed no piece.

auto_decisions.description: QUESTION_ADVISED lines of the runs of the session.

recoveries.description: Resumes after a crash, a hang or a one-time failure.

current.description: The launch intent of a child conductor (state launching, written before the child is started) and, after its acknowledgement, the child itself (state running).

launch_id.description: Nonce of this launch: the detach acknowledgement of the child must carry it.

state.description: launching (the intent is written, no acknowledgement yet) or running.

kind.description: The conductor verb: run (a new lane), continue (answered questions) or resume (recovery, quota reset, one-time failure).

items.description: The pieces of a new lane.

pid.description: Process id of the child conductor, after the acknowledgement.

start_ticks.description: Start time of the child in clock ticks since boot, null when unknown.

boot_id.description: Boot id of the machine the child was started (or adopted) in; with pid and start_ticks the identity a signal needs, null when unknown.

since.description: UTC time the intent was written.

waiting.description: A run that waits for answers.

since.description: UTC time it began to wait.

history.description: One run the session started or adopted.

kind.description: The verb of the last launch for this run.

started_at.description: UTC time of the first launch.

ended_at.description: UTC time of the last end, null while it runs.

exit.description: Exit code the run ended with (0, 1, 4, 130), null when it never started or is not over.

status.description: running, finished, stopped, waiting, interrupted, orphaned or never_started.

reason_code.description: Stop code of the run, null when none.

auto_decisions.description: QUESTION_ADVISED lines of its journal already counted in counters.auto_decisions.

blocker.description: A piece a run left blocked.

code.description: Its code (the stop or escalation code).

stop.description: The stop code of the session, its message and time.

message.description: What happened and the one action that goes on.
